programme.title: Слово на сей час. Всё могу во Христе
programme.desc: «Всё могу в укрепляющем меня Иисусе Христе», – написал однажды апостол Павел. Многие верующие ему вторят, но почему-то успеха в христианской жизни так и не имеют. Что значит эта фраза? Что действительно может делать искренний христианин, а чего он не может? Идет ли в тексте речь о каких-то сверхъестественных способностях? И как обстоят дела с чтением Библии, молитвой, посещение церкви, добрыми делами – даёт ли Бог силу для этого? Ведущий: Виталий Киссер, священнослужитель

programme.title: Библия. Лютер и Библия
programme.desc: Многосерийный фильм «Библия». Протестантская Реформация в 2017 году отметила свой 500-летний юбилей. Мартин Лютер, с именем которого неразрывно связано это историческое событие, перевел Библию на немецкий язык и дал право толковать Священное Писание каждому человеку. Какие принципы Реформации провозгласил Лютер? Кто в истории России первым перевел Библию на родной язык и тем самым внес большой вклад в духовное развитие страны? Ведущий: Иван Лобанов, ведущий научный сотрудник Института перевода Библии им. М. П.Кулакова, Гость: А. Десницкий, доктор филологических наук, профессор РАН, Ю. Друми, доктор богословия, Н. Шабуров, профессор, директор Центра Изучения Религий РГГУ, о. игумен Иннокентий (Павлов), кандидат богословия, член правления РБО, С. Ряховский, Начальствующий Епископ Российского объединенного союза христиан веры евангельской, член Совета по взаимодействию с религиозными объединениями при Президенте РФ, Н. Гузов

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: The Tuscan Archipelago is a group of islands at the height of Florence. The archipelago stretches from the Ligurian Sea to the Tyrrhenian Sea, north-east of Corsica. The archipelago consists of seven main islands - Giglio, Elba, Gianutri, Capraia, Pianisoa, Gorgona and Montecristo - and other smaller islands and rocks. Not all of them are inhabited. We look at the three most extraordinary islands of the archipelago: Elba, Capraia and the island of Montecristo. The Tuscan Archipelago is one of the most important natural wonders of the world and is protected as Parco Nazionale dell'Arcipelago Toscano. With its 61.474 hectares of protected and 17,694 hectares of protected land area, it is the largest marine protected area in in Europe. Capraia is the third largest island of the archipelago and is located with its small harbor in the channel in front of Corsica. The island is an autonomous municipality with about 300 inhabitants. It is also considered the most maritime island of the archipelago. At the end of the eighties, the penal colony on Capraia was closed was closed and the island opened to tourism.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Far from the glamour and spotlight of Lampedusa, Pantelleria is one of the best kept secrets among the Italian islands. Located closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria closer to Tunisia than to the Italian mainland, Pantelleria has been nicknamed "The Last Island," a title also given by Giosuè Calaciura gave to his 2016 historical novel set on Pantelleria. Pantelleria, that is the island of lava, capers and of the liqueur wine that comes here Zibibbo. An island with an ancient history, where for centuries farmers and fishermen have pursued their craft. their craft. The famous Zibibbo grapes are cultivated here - among other things also on the vineyard that Gerard Depardieu and his wife Carole Bouquet bought to produce traditional liqueur and nutmeg wine themselves and distribute it worldwide. The cuisine of the island is as much Arabic as Italian, couscous with fish is a typical island dish.

programme.title: mareTV: Venice - Lagoon and Legend
programme.desc: Venice has been attracting people as if by magic for centuries. The Italians call her La Serenissima, or the sublime. Perched on wooden posts, she braves the elements and the huge, annual surge of visitors. Vogalonga is the name of a Venetian sports competition for women, in which the participants row their boats standing. This is a tradition that Guilia and Elena also follow. They train hard, as the yearly regatta is soon to begin. Anyone caught driving their water vehicle with more than 7 km/h through the canals of Venice, risks getting a ticket from local policewoman Lorenza Mariutti. The reason: the resulting waves gnaw at the foundations of the grand palaces. Venetians are very attached to their traditional cuisine. The island of Sant' Erasmo is the town's garden. Artichokes, radicchio, onions, everything that grows here is said to taste fantastic, thanks to the salt content of the air and water. Carlo and Claudio Finotello not only grow the vegetables, they even deliver directly to their customers' doors. At sunset, they sail through the lagoon with their boat, brimming with produce, towards San Marco. People waiting at the many bridges, now receive their wares: regional, seasonal, fresh. And without a hint of stress if possible. Like so many other things in Venice. Perhaps because La Serenissima is also known as "The Composed".

programme.title: Germany's Wild Amazon
programme.desc: As one of Germany’s beauties, the river was the gem of Germanys landscape. But with industrialization it became the country’s hardest working river and like everything that has been overworked, it lost it magnificence and charm. Due to tender love and care, the river is now a reigning example of one of the most successful and outstanding renaturation projects in the country.The film shows never before seen shots of the river now pulsing with life. We will show you the winding river bed, spawning salmon, mating crabs and still-growing anchor ice. You will see dipper birds searching for food under water, kingfishers catching fish, a family life of badgers, foxes and a wide variety of birds. Come and meet the resurrected river Wupper!

programme.title: Vicious Beauties - The secret World of the Jelly Fish
programme.desc: Watching the graceful movement of these gelatinous animals is almost hypnotic. Although their bodies are 98% water, jellyfish are deceptively clever and dangerous. But where do these primordial creatures come from? How do they reproduce and how long do they live?

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: The journey up the coast continues through Delaware to suburban New Jersey, and onwards into the heart of Manhattan. In Delaware, famous as a corporate tax haven, we visit a winery. In New York City we zip around with a bicycle courier and then head out to Long Island for oysters.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: Nowhere is the American way of life as relaxed as on Florida's beaches. The Keys, a chain of islands at the far southern end of the state, reveal a more laid-back side of the USA. But all of Florida amazes -- with secluded beaches, unspoiled nature, and the legacy of the early European settlers.

programme.title: The U.S. East Coast
programme.desc: From New York, the journey up the coast leads into the heart of New England. We visit Yale; spend some time in the 19th century mansions at Newport, RI; tour the coastal fishing and vacation towns of Massachusetts, and then meet a modern entrepreneur in Boston and see her rooftop gardens.

programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: mareTV: Scotland's Mild West - On The Inner Hebrides
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: Moon, The: Our Gateway To The Universe
programme.desc: We are on the verge of a new age of exploration: besides the plans of NASA and other space agencies, over the next years also privately financed teams are going to send unmanned vehicles to the Moon. The goal is to find a cheap and efficient way to travel there on a regular basis, and in the long term to build a permanent human base.

programme.title: mareTV: Capri and the Amalfi Coast - Italy's Ocean Legends
programme.desc: Capri was already in ancient times a place for the rich and beautiful. Today Capri is one of the most famous islands in the world. Millions of tourists visit it. But there are in fact still unknown corners on the island in the Gulf of Naples. Thus, at the very top of Capri, there is a hermit monastery with a view to the Vesuvius.

programme.title: Wild & Wide Awake - From the Mediterranean to the Alps
programme.desc: The first part of the spring journey takes us from the Spanish inland to the rugged Atlantic and to the Mediterranean, through the French Provence, and finally into the Alps. Along the way, flamingos perform their bizarre dancing rituals, wild horses storm through the wetland… While the North is still covered by snow and ice, the South will soon turn into a blooming garden and every creature is enjoying the first signs of the awakening.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Rugged coasts, untouched nature and the rough climate of the Atlantic characterize the landscape on the west coast of Scotland. In the sounds and lochs of the Scottish West, "Waverley", the last seaworthy passenger steamship in the world, appears once a year. The side-wheel steamer was built in 1947 to carry out short ferry passages on the Clyde River. Today, "Waverley" circumnavigates almost all of Great Britain. The impressive ship was sold to the "Paddle Steamer Preservation Society" in 1974 for the symbolic price of one English pound. Since then, she starts her season off the Western Isles in Scotland every year in May.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: Idlewild - Avalon - Belle of Louisville - these three names stand for the last still roadworthy, historic sternwheeler in the USA. In 1914, the ship was built as "Idlewild" for the West Memphis Packet Company as a passenger ferry. With a draft of only 1.50 m and a robust steel hull, the boat is suitable for almost all navigable rivers of the Mississippi River system. Today, the "Belle" is the most traveled steamboat in American history. In the course of her eventful life, she has called at 130 places in 19 states.

programme.title: Legendary Paddle Steamers
programme.desc: With a length of more than 1000 kilometers, the Elbe is one of the largest rivers in Europe. The river has shaped landscapes since time immemorial: geologically, economically and culturally. One of the most beautiful sections of the river - in Saxony in southeastern Germany - has been navigated by the Saxon Steamship Company since 1836. One of its most beautiful ships is the Diesbar. Its engine is considered the oldest paddle steamer engine still in use in the world, the ship is the only steamer in the fleet still powered by coal.

programme.title: Italy's Uncharted Islands
programme.desc: Lake Iseo is located on the southern foothills of the Alps. It extends over the provinces of Brescia and Bergamo in the northern mainland of Italy. In the middle of Lake Iseo lies the largest island of the southern European inland waters. Monte Isola, as the island is called after its central mountain lies close to its two neighboring islands, Isola di San Paolo and Isola di Loreto. As early as the 11th century, a monastic association of Benedictines settled here. For many Italians, Lake Iseo is the most beautiful spot in their homeland. It is all the more astonishing how little the influence of tourism is here. Driving is strictly forbidden on the three islands, and only on Monte Isola. Only on Monte Isola there is a regular bus service in the summertime. Thus, the three islands are an oasis of an oasis of tranquility most of the year. The historical buildings and the nature remind of the long tradition in which the Italians have cultivated this retreat. Only every five years in the autumn a big celebration takes place. Then over 200,000 paper flowers decorate the island. The flowers are reminiscent of the time in the Middle Ages when a Roma woman brought her son to the island to be cured from the from the rampant plague. In gratitude, she donated a sea of flowers. The Festa di Santa Croce has been one of the main attractions in northern Italy ever since. The days are radiant with color, it is the only time when it gets crowded in the small streets of the island villages. The next festival was celebrated in September 2021.

programme.title: Dòtaman
programme.desc: Tha Dòtaman a' falbh air làithean saora anns a' phrògram spòrsail seo bho 1989. Thèid air turas cuide ri Donaidh agus Rhoda 's iad a' cluich, a' seinn agus ag innse storaidh mu chuspair làithean saora. Tha Cagnaidh is Crotal deiseal is deònach agus bidh Nelson is Napoleon gu dileas aig gleoca nam pioghaid - feuch gum bi sibh deiseal airson innse dè an uair a tha e? Dotaman goes on holiday in this colourful classic from the archives. Join Donnie and Rhoda as they dress up, sing and share a story on the topic. Furry friends Cagnaidh and Crotal join in the fun, while Nelson and Napoleon keep time at the Dotaman clock!

programme.title: Meaban and Moo
programme.desc: Bidh Linda a’ tadhal air a caraidean Meaban is Moo sa bhothan aca gus dùbhlain spòrsail a chur romhpa. Anns a’ phrògram seo tha i ag iarraidh orra trì rudan orains a lorg. Tha treallaich gu leòr sa bhothan agus feumaidh Meaban is Moo a dhol a rùraich! Linda visits her friends Meaban and Moo at their hut to set them fun challenges. She tasks them with finding three orange items. Their hut is full of junk so Meaban and Moo need to have a good rummage!

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: Tha Àtaidh a’ feuchainn ri bàrdachd a’ sgrìobhadh. Tha Tilidh dìreach airson fuaim a dhèanamh. ’S dòcha gun lorg iad dòigh air an dà rud a dhèanamh còmhla. Abney is trying to write poems. Teal just wants to make noise! Maybe they can find a way to do both together.

programme.title: Ladybird & Bee/Daolag-bhreac is Seillean
programme.desc: Tha Daolag-bhreac is Seillean a’ dèanamh danns’ le seanganan an-diugh. Ladybird and Bee dance with ants today.

programme.title: Dan & Gran
programme.desc: Beach shoes have gone missing and red hair is found at the scene - Grumblestunk is blaming Stan! Who really did it? Stan and Gran spy a mystery! Tha brògan traghad air a dhol a dhìth; tha falt ruadh ga lorg aig an làraich 's tha Greannarlobht a' coireachadh Dan! Ach cò tha cionntach? Tha rùn-dìomhair ro Dan is Gran!

programme.title: Stòiridh
programme.desc: Sgeulachdan do chlann òga. Tha Dòmhnall Ruadh a’ leughadh Litir Herman. Chaidh an leabhar a sgrìobhadh agus a dhealbhachadh le Tom Percival agus chaidh eadar-theangachadh dhan Ghàidhlig le Dòmhnall Iain MacLeòid. A bedtime story for young children. Donald Smith reads Litir Herman, written and illustrated by Tom Percival, and translated into Gaelic by Donald John MacLeod.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha e an urra ri na Pluic Fèis Bhliadhnail na Coimhearsnachd a chur air dòigh am bliadhna, ach tha na nàbaidhean farmadach aca, na h-Àrdain, a’ feuchainn ris a’ ghnothach a mhilleadh orra. It is the Spuds’ turn to run Grim Fest, the annual festival at Grimsby Heights, but their jealous neighbours, The Dups, are out to sabotage their efforts.

programme.title: An Saoghal Droil aig Pol Ploc/The Rubbish World of Dave Spud
programme.desc: Tha Pòl sgìth de riaghailtean a mhàthar agus athar. Tha e a’ fuireach san amar ùine airson cabhag a chur air an aois, is tha seo ga thionndadh na bhodach rocach. A-nis ’s urrainn dha fhèin na riaghailtean a chruthachadh. Dave is tired of following his mum and dad’s rules. Creating a reverse fountain of youth in the bathtub, he shrivels himself into an old man and sets about making up rules of his own.

programme.title: Stri
programme.desc: Tha preasantairean CBBC ALBA uabhasach fhèin measail air dùbhlain ach saoil cò shoirbhicheas is Mateo a’ tadhal orra? The CBBC ALBA presenters love a good challenge, but who will emerge victorious as Mateo joins them?

programme.title: Am Piano/The Piano
programme.desc: Tha piàno draoidheil a’ toirt teaghlach briste air ais còmhla. A magical piano helps mend a broken family.

programme.title: A’ Chùil
programme.desc: Tha Choirstaidh air ais le prògram eile bhon stiùidio aice, A’ Chùil. Anns a’ phrògram seo tha i a’ sealltainn dhut mar a nì thu pù agus speuclairean fuadain. A bharrachd air a sin, seallaidh I dhut mar a nì thu dealbh sgoinneil dhe do shùilean. Choirstaidh shows you how to make pretend poo and fake glasses. She also gives you a few pointers on how to draw a great picture of eyes.

programme.title: Dùbhlain DIY (Instructions Not Included)
programme.desc: The judges set the remaining four couples DIY challenges for the home.

programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc: Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work and communication. We meet diligent learners who have embraced speaking Gaelic, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland. Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Lios Mhàiri/Mairi’s Hebridean Garden
programme.desc: Tha Màiri dripeil anns an lios agus a’ tadhal air dà ghàirnealair inntinneach. Mairi’s back at work in her island garden, seeking inspiration from other keen growers.

programme.title: Hebridean Baker - Nordic Islands
programme.desc: Coinneach MacLeod explores the food traditions of Lofoten in Norway. Tha Coinneach MacLeòid a’ faighinn a-mach mu chultaran a’ bhidhe ann an Lofoten ann a Nirribhidh.

programme.title: Rurachd (Foraging)
programme.desc: Lucy visits a favourite east coast location to show Mary Ann seabuckthorn, which grows in shoreline dunes.

programme.title: Miann na Maighdinn-mara/Mermaid Tales
programme.desc: Kate keeps heading south and meets up with Liam Crouse, who takes her out for a trip around Lochboisdale.

programme.title: Faodail
programme.desc: Tha Tasglann Fhilm Faodail a’ tarraing aire gu filmichean dhùthchasach Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 80an, a bha caillte ach a-nis glèidhte don ghinealach ri teachd. Tha bhana Cinema Sgìre Leantainneach a’ siubhal nan eilean, a’ taisbeanadh fhilmichean sna sgìrean ionadail, le cothrom am faicinn air-loidhne air feadh an t-saoghail. Cuirear aithris bheairteach ùr riutha, a’ buntainn ris a’ Ghàidhealtachd, airson luchd-amhairc an là an-diugh. The Faodail Film Archive celebrates lost indigenous film collections from the 1930s-1980s in the Outer Hebrides, preserving the archive for future generations. The Cinema Sgìre Continuing mobile cinema van travels the islands showcasing footage to local communities, making them accessible globally online and adding rich new narratives relevant to the Gàidhealtachd for contemporary audiences. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Machair
programme.desc: Drama Gàidhlig stèidhichte ann an Leòdhas. Gaelic soap set on the Isle of Lewis.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Là àbhaisteach eile ann a Fraochy Bay... agus cùisean a' dol bun os cionn. An turus-sa tha maor-trafaig 's a' bhaile nach eil mothachail air mar a tha a fhradharc a' dol bhuaithe. Feumaidh muinntir a' bhaile smachd fhaighinn air a ghnothaich. Fraochy Bay's peace and quiet is shattered once again. This time at the hands of a short-sighted traffic warden who causes havoc in the town. It's up to the residents to find a creative solution.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Prògram spioradail le laoidhean, sailm agus leughaidhean bho Coats ann am Pàislig, air a lìbhrigeadh le Iain MacFhionghain. Am measg na seinneadairean bidh Amy NicAoidh, Emma NicLeòid agus Seumas Greumach. Cuideachd, an còisir Soisgeul fo stiùir Gareth Fuller. Bidh Dolina NicMhathain a’ meòrachadh air cuspair creideimh le leughadh agus smuain, dàn is seallaidhean spioradail à Tiriodh ann an companachd Dòmhnall Eachann Meek agus bidh seirm adhraidh air a’ phìob aig Chloe Steele à Manachainn nan Lios. Iain MacKinnon presents the spiritual series with a mix of hymns, psalms and readings from Coats in Paisley. Among the singers performing are Amy MacKay, Emma MacLeod and James Graham. Plus the choir Soisgeul conducted by Gareth Fuller. Dolina Matheson reflects on her beliefs with a selected reading and thought, spiritual poetry and landscapes in the company of Donald E Meek in Tiree and Chloe Steele performs a tune of worship on the pipes from Beauly Priory. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Atlantis: Telemón
programme.desc: Mientras Jasón lucha por la gloria en el campo del torneo, Ariadna se embarca en su propia batalla privada. El suyo es un concurso de cabeza sobre corazón, pero solo ella puede decidir cuál triunfará.

programme.title: Atlantis: El matrimonio de las mentes verdaderas

programme.title: Atlantis: El día de los Muertos

programme.title: Atlantis: Las hermanas grises
programme.desc: Mientras Ariadna yace en su lecho de muerte, la culpa de Jasón es casi insoportable. Decide hacer todo lo posible para salvarla y se embarca en una peligrosa búsqueda hacia lo desconocido.

programme.title: Atlantis: Un destino peor que la muerte
programme.sub-title: Un destino peor que la muerte
programme.desc: Cuando la noticia llega a Pasífae sobre el inminente matrimonio de Ariadna y Jasón, está aterrorizada de que Atlantis se pierda para siempre y decide hacer todo lo posible para detener la unión.

programme.title: Atlantis: La locura de Hércules
programme.desc: A medida que Pasífae aumenta su control sobre la Atlántida, el futuro parece sombrío. Hércules sabe que solo hay una forma de salvar a sus amigos: Medusa. ¿Es un riesgo que está dispuesto a correr?

programme.title: Atlantis: La mirada de la Gorgona
programme.desc: Pasífae se ha apoderado de Atlantis y solo una cosa es segura: se necesitará un sacrificio de proporciones inimaginables para arreglar las cosas.

programme.title: Atlantis: La muerte de la luz
programme.desc: La profecía del Oráculo se ha hecho realidad: las revelaciones sobre Pasífae han ennegrecido el corazón de Jasón. Desesperado por salvar a su amigo, Pitágoras parte en busca de ayuda.

programme.title: Atlantis: Familiares
programme.desc: Cuando nuestros héroes descubren que Jasón ha sido atrapado por las tropas de Pasífae, saben que deben hacer todo lo posible para rescatarlo antes de que se pierda para siempre.

programme.title: The Great Food Guys
programme.desc: Nick Nairn and Dougie Vipond celebrate the fantastic range of food and drink Scotland has to offer. In this episode, they focus on meat and cook a rack of Scotch lamb with roast miso aubergine and sauce vierge. Joining them in the kitchen are shepherdess Michelle Stephen from Aberdeenshire and comedian farmer Jim Smith, who selects a local Perthshire beer to accompany the food.

programme.title: This Farming Life
programme.desc: Autumn brings challenges and rewards for farmers across Scotland. In Inverkip, Rachel and Camy are one year into building their own farm, taking on a tenancy at Dunrod Farm and a big bank loan with the dream of one day owning 5,000 sheep. But a trip to market means higher prices scupper their best intentions. In Maybole in South Ayrshire, the Barclay family are getting to grips with their new business venture – buying store lambs to fatten up for the butcher. After John’s father died suddenly last year, he’s trying to make their fourth generation farm work for them. A half-term break means a leisurely family day out… to the sheep auction. And in Moray, Nikki, Ollie and their children team up to process a bumper harvest of apples into juice for the whole year. Later, they find out if one of their favourite buffalo is pregnant.

programme.title: Murder Trial
programme.desc: With Brian’s family desperately seeking justice and answers, the fate of the accused hangs in the balance. Witnesses unearth more shocking revelations, and the defendant takes the stand before the jury answer the ultimate question: guilty or not guilty? As the police investigation team finally close in on their suspect, the court is shown dramatic footage from Campbell’s custody interview, where tempers flare when allegations are put to him. The prosecution point to a guilty man on the ropes, while the defence argue it shows a police force under pressure to get their man. As the case builds to a climax, with persuasive and gripping closing speeches from both sides, Campbell awaits his fate whilst Brian’s grieving family anxiously await justice – either way, lives will change forever.

programme.title: David Wilson's Crime Files
programme.desc: Criminologist David Wilson studies the psychology behind the need for those who lead a life of crime to have to conceal their activities by leading a secret or double life.

programme.title: Scotcast

programme.title: Icons of Football
programme.desc: Gary McAllister made the game of football look easy. The proverbial classy midfield player who saw the full picture, and could affect it, in the crucial seconds before his opponent. Unprepared to succumb to a story that began with knock-backs, Gary wrote his own place in the history and folklore of every club he played for - a winner at Motherwell, champion at Leeds, immortal at Liverpool, and a Scotland captain of some repute. But there were lows to counter the highs, and Gary discusses these with searing honesty. However, he is not defined by the hard times, but rather the moments where his class and will to win elevated him to the very top of the game. With contributions from Steven Gerrard, Gordon Strachan and Ardal O’Hanlon, this is the story of one of the greatest Scotland players of his, or any, generation.

programme.desc: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Nina Conti, Nick Helm, Athena Kugblenu and Toby Tarrant take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games decanter, or will they be tempted by the House of Games kitchen composter, which is brand new for this series?

programme.title: The Finish Line
programme.desc: Roman Kemp and his sidekick Sarah Greene host this quiz show, where the contestants race on moving podiums across the studio floor. Correct answers get the players moving, while wrong answers stop them in their tracks. Five contestants battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races, where the aim of the game is simple – make it to the finish line before your rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the £5,000 cash prize.

programme.title: Do You Know Your Place?
programme.desc: The competition steps up a gear as presenter Owain Wyn Evans, Olympic champion Greg Rutherford and Blue Peter’s Abby Cook return for day two of the quiz. Vernon Kay keeps control as host, while Paul Gorton leads an unreliable tour of Taunton, delivering fun facts with the odd curveball.

programme.title: Animal Park
programme.desc: When one of the park’s pygmy goats unexpectedly goes into labour, it’s a worrying time for the keepers. Meanwhile, Ben helps the keepers sex their young pancake tortoises.

programme.title: Serengeti
programme.desc: After a storm, the vast landscape is flooded, and all the families battle to reach higher ground. But as the flood waters rise, the danger of being washed away grows too.

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow
programme.desc: Michael Aspel presents the show in which members of the public are invited to bring along their antiques for examination. In the gardens of Sudeley Castle in Gloucestershire, the experts look over a fine regulator clock, a sapphire pendant, Winchcombe pottery and a pouch traded with a dentist by Native Americans in exchange for pulling teeth.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin is joined by experts James Lewis and Mark Stacey at Guildford Cathedral. Together the team pick out a selection of interesting antiques and collectables to be sold at a local auction. James discovers a collection of Doulton dogs, and Mark falls in love with a mahogany window seat. But the real star of the show is a fascinating and unusual Italian ring. Paul also takes a look at the history of the cathedral itself and finds out how the local people played their part in the building's construction.

programme.title: Richard Osman's House of Games
programme.desc: Every day this week, former winners Edith Bowman, Rhys James, Anita Rani and Simon Rimmer take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, quiz legend Richard Osman. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall House of Champions winner being crowned on Friday. Will they opt for the House of Games golden cowboy hat, or instead go for the must-have golden wheelie luggage?

programme.title: Bear Grylls - Wild Reckoning
programme.desc: Twenty-eight-year-old Cameron wants his dad to stop acting like a child and be more of a father figure to him. Dad, Mark, has a history of getting drunk on nights out and holidays, wearing his comedy English breakfast face mask in shops and supermarkets, and generally embarrassing Cameron, who has pleaded with him on many occasions to grow up. On the flip side, Mark says his son can be self-centred, and he doesn’t always feel able to confide in him. Bear sets the pair a water-collecting task to help them discover the power of teamwork – if they can stop bickering. Then, they’re tasked with preparing pheasant on the campfire for dinner. In a conversation with psychologist Tara, Cam reveals that his dad’s unwillingness to take his feelings into consideration feels like a rejection. Mark confides that he hasn’t always been able to open up to Cameron – even concealing a recent health scare. The pair take on an epic rescue mission in the dramatic landscape of a north Wales quarry. The only way to succeed is if they learn to pull together, communicate and bond as father and son.

programme.title: Nigellissima
programme.desc: Nigella shares the secrets of delicious Italian-inspired food. She treats her friends to an Italian-style supper of pork loin stuffed with parma ham and oregano, served alongside her speedy mock mash and lazy person's vignarola - a recipe based on the traditional Roman spring stew of broad beans, peas and artichokes. For her pasta dish, Nigella is cooking spelt spaghetti - an earthy choice to match a fresh, no-cook olive and anchovy sauce. And Nigella's weekend indulgence is sambuca kisses - delicate, doughnut-like treats, so light that one would never be enough.

programme.title: Race Against the Tide
programme.desc: The sand-sculpting competition kicks off on St Andrews Beach as seven teams race to create seaside-inspired masterpieces in just six hours, before the tide sweeps in. From nostalgic caravans to cheeky seagulls, creativity meets chaos under the watchful eyes of judges Sadie and Jamie. Who will wow and who will wash out in this high-stakes battle against nature?

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: The Porthcawl crew respond to a 999 call about a local fisherman who’s fallen overboard. As they discover the casualty’s identity, their search becomes increasingly desperate. Out in the English Channel, there are reports of a dangerously overcrowded small boat in the shipping lanes. As the Dungeness crew head to the location, they find that there are 62 casualties - and the boat they’re crowded into is now breaking up. In North Berwick, a call comes in from a woman whose husband has been blown out to sea on a kayak that has capsized. And off the coast of Scarborough, a yacht with an elderly crew on board has lost all power - and sunset is fast approaching.

In this third and final case, Danny Robins meets Heather, who, 30 years ago, moves into a student house with two friends – a house which they believe is haunted by a malevolent entity. Events become so frightening that the group are compelled to call in an exorcist - but the exorcism doesn’t go according to plan. It’s one of the most unsettling cases Danny has ever come across. But could it simply be a shared delusion? To find an answer, Danny must track down Heather’s housemates to find out what they remember about the events. Assisting him in his search for answers are Dr Ciarán O’Keeffe and parapsychologist Evelyn Hollow.

Die regionalen Berichte werden häufig durch sorgfältig recherchiertes Hintergrundwissen ergänzt. Das Format umfasst zudem Beiträge zu Kultur und Musik. Gelegentlich führen die Moderatoren Gespräche mit Studiogästen zu aktuellen Themen. Darüber hinaus werden Entwicklungen aus Politik, Gesellschaft und Alltag regelmäßig eingeordnet und verständlich vermittelt.

programme.title: BR24
programme.desc: BR24 - Aus der BR24-Redaktion kommt täglich eine 15-minütige BR24-Sendung um 16.00 Uhr und die halbstündige Hauptausgabe mit Sportblock um 18.30 Uhr sowie eine Ausgabe um 21.45 Uhr. An Sonntagen und Feiertagen ist auch die Hauptausgabe 15 Minuten lang, die Spätausgabe beginnt am Sonntag in der Regel erst um 23.00 Uhr. Montags bis freitags wird ferner zwischen 8.00 bis 15.00 Uhr fünf Ausgaben der BR24-100-Sekunden-News gesendet. Darüber hinaus bietet BR24 ein strukturiertes Nachrichtenprogramm mit festen Ressorts wie Bayern, Kultur, Wirtschaft und Sport.

programme.title: Gesundheit!
programme.desc: Gesundheit! - Themen: Diabetes Typ 2 Kreuzbandriss Medizin, die etwas bewegt, ohne Risiken und Nebenwirkungen: Das zeigt die Fernsehreihe "Die Bewegungs-Docs". Die "Docs" sind: Melanie Hümmelgen, Christian Sturm und Helge Riepenhof, sie alle sind erfahrene Mediziner und wollen mit gezielten Bewegungsstrategien Symptome deutlich verbessern und Krankheiten heilen. Diabetes Typ 2 Süßigkeiten im Büro, zu wenig Bewegung und dauerhaftes Sitzen - für Jennifer Schweer haben diese Gewohnheiten ernste Folgen: Diabetes Typ 2, Übergewicht und Fettleber. Die 48-Jährige fühlt sich erschöpft, ist schnell außer Atem und kaum noch belastbar. In "Die Bewegungs-Docs" übernimmt Melanie Hümmelgen ihren Fall und setzt auf ...

programme.title: Best of Dahoam is Dahoam!
programme.desc: Des war wuid! - Die Ranking-Show "Best of Dahoam is Dahoam!" beleuchtet noch einmal die großen Highlights der beliebten BR-Serie. Ein ausgewähltes Thema steht jeweils im Fokus der einzelnen Sendung, Darstellerinnen und Darsteller der Serie kommentieren das Gesehene. Innerhalb eines unterhaltsamen Countdowns wird von den "DiD"-Machern der beliebteste Beitrag gekürt. In "Best of Dahoam is Dahoam! - Des war wuid!" zeigt Lansing seine wohl aufregendste Seite: Wenn plötzlich alles aus dem Ruder läuft, wenn ein Plan nach hinten losgeht oder ein Moment das ganze Dorf in Atem hält. Die Ranking-Show versammelt die fünf krassesten Ausnahmezustände der Seriengeschichte - Geschichten, die für Nervenkitzel, ...

programme.title: Tagesschau
programme.desc: Tagesschau - Seit 1952 wird die Nachrichtensendung präsentiert. Sie informiert täglich über die wichtigsten Ereignisse aus Politik, Wirtschaft, Gesellschaft, Kultur und Sport. Die Sendung bietet einen kompakten und verlässlichen Überblick über das nationale und internationale Geschehen. Reporterinnen und Reporter sowie Korrespondentinnen und Korrespondenten berichten aus dem In- und Ausland und ordnen aktuelle Entwicklungen verständlich und fundiert ein. Neben den aktuellen Nachrichten werden Hintergründe, Zusammenhänge und Einordnungen vermittelt, die das Geschehen in einen größeren Kontext setzen. Dabei steht eine präzise, sachliche und unabhängige Berichterstattung im Mittelpunkt.

programme.desc: Nur Müll im Kopf - Bei Martha (Veronika Fitz) steht ein runder Geburtstag vor der Tür, doch von einer Feier möchte sie nichts wissen. Allerdings hat sie die Rechnung ohne Costa (Janis Kyriakidis) gemacht. Obwohl bei Martha Haslbeck ein runder Geburtstag vor der Tür steht, will sie auf eine Feier und Geschenke in diesem Jahr verzichten. Doch Costa gibt sich nicht geschlagen und beweist, dass er Martha an Hartnäckigkeit und Einfallsreichtum in nichts nachsteht. programme.title: Mord in bester Gesellschaft - Alles Böse zum Hochzeitstag
programme.desc: Alles Böse zum Hochzeitstag - Der Psychiater Wendelin Winter macht Urlaub an der Ostsee. Hier trifft er auf seine ehemalige Patientin Rita Theisen. Die Millionärin steht kurz vor der Hochzeit mit dem sehr viel jüngeren Ricky Römer. Ritas erwachsene Kinder halten den künftigen Ehemann ihrer Mutter für einen Erbschleicher. Nachdem Ricky am Vorabend der Hochzeit erschossen wurde, bittet Rita Theisen Wendelin Winter um Hilfe.

programme.title: Kommissar Wallander - Der Mann, der lächelte
programme.desc: Der Mann, der lächelte - Wallander (Kenneth Branagh) erhält Besuch von seinem alten Freund Sten Torstensson (David Sibley). Der Anwalt befürchtet, dass sein Vater entgegen offizieller Polizeiermittlungen ermordet wurde. Als auch Sten unter mysteriösen Umständen zu Tode kommt, übernimmt der Kommissar den merkwürdigen Fall. Anonyme Morddrohungen, die Torstensson und sein Client, ein reicher Wohltäter, kurz zuvor erhielten, führen Wallander auf die Spur eines illegalen Geschäfts mit Spenderorganen. Wallander steckt in seiner bislang schwersten Krise. Dass er in Notwehr einen Menschen erschießen musste, verkraftet er nicht. programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert, während der General erneut hundert Kandidaten versammelt, die den Felsenkanal, das Frühstück und die Fallgrube überwinden müssen, bevor sie die Burg von Takeshi stürmen können. Hat einer von ihnen das Zeug dazu?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hunderte Kandidaten wollen die Burg erstürmen und den General stolz machen. Doch kann sich einer von ihnen trotz des Bowlingspiels, der Grenzmauer und der Hängebrücke den Sieg holen? Kommentiert wird das Ganze von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Russell Kane kommentiert die hoffnungsvollen Versuche, die Burg zu erstürmen. Doch schafft es jemand, die rutschige Grenzmauer zu überwinden? Mehr Kandidaten, mehr Herausforderungen und sogar noch mehr Matsch zum Steckenbleiben.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hundert neue Kämpfer wollen die Burg erstürmen und den General stolz machen. Doch wer kann den Fliegenpilz, den Felsenkanal und die Hängebrücke überwinden? Kommentiert wird das Ganze von Russell Kane.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Thailand
programme.desc: Hier ist das Beste von Takeshi! Russel Kane präsentiert die Triumphe (und die lustigsten Patzer) in der Geschichte von Takeshi. Es gibt Sumo, die Hängebrücke und all das, was ihr nicht mehr vergessen könnt. Wer wird der König der Könige?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Es gibt Matsch und Chaos in der neuen Staffel von 'Takeshi’s Castle'. Einhundert neue Kandidaten stellen sich der verrückten Bienenwabe und der Rutschwand, bevor sie die Burg stürmen können. Roman Kemp moderiert.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während 100 Kandidaten Herausforderungen wie die lustige Rutschwand bezwingen, um die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen. Haben sie das Zeug, die Wachen zu besiegen und den Sieg für sich zu beanspruchen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während sich eine brandneue Gruppe von Kandidaten durch völlig bekloppte Aufgaben kämpft, um die Burg von Takeshi einzunehmen. Die Kandidaten rutschen aus und fallen hin, vor allem an der 'Rutschwand'.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Finden die Kandidaten einen Weg aus dem Wabenlabyrinth, ohne nass zu werden? 100 neue Wettstreiter versuchen, den Wachen zu entkommen und absurde Herausforderungen wie 'Strandgammler' zu bestreiten. Roman Kemp moderiert.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während die Kandidaten unter den wachsamen Augen von General Fero dem ultimativen Sieg entgegenstolpern. Hoffentlich können sie sich lang genug am Fliegenpilz festklammern, um zur Burg von Takeshi zu gelangen.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia: 506
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während die neuen Kandidaten einen wunden Po in 'Strandgammler' bekommen und sich einen Weg über das 'harte Pflaster' bahnen, bis sie die Burg von Takeshi einnehmen können.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Einhundert Kandidaten versuchen, dem Wasser (und den Dämonen) der Bienenwabe zu entkommen und riesige Kugeln im Bowlingspiel zu bezwingen. Sie wollen die Bürg stürmen und gewinnen. Wird es ihnen gelingen? Roman Kemp moderiert.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während sich einhundert mutige Kandidaten ihren Weg zur Burg von Takeshi erkämpfen. Es gibt Wasser, Matsch und fliegende Pilze. Nur die Starken schaffen es bis zur Burg.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während sich neue Kandidaten ihren Weg zur Burg von Takeshi erkämpfen. Doch wird es ihnen gelingen, trotz Rutschwand, Strandgammler und Fliegenpilz den Sieg für sich zu beanspruchen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während 100 Kandidaten Herausforderungen wie die lustige Rutschwand bezwingen, um die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen. Haben sie das Zeug, die Wachen zu besiegen und den Sieg für sich zu beanspruchen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Eine brandneue Staffel von 'Takeshi’s Castle' mit 100 mutigen Kandidaten. Euch erwarten Spaß, Stürze und natürlich Niederlagen! Roman Kemp überwacht den Wahnsinn, darunter auch den Takeshi-Klassiker 'Bienenwabe'.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Einhundert mutige neue Kandidaten bezwingen neue Takeshi-Aufgaben wie den 'Drahtseilakt' und 'Jetzt siehst du mich' auf ihrer Mission, als Sieger die Burg zu stürmen. Wird es ihnen gelingen? Moderiert von Roman Kemp.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: 100 Kandidaten riskieren alles, um die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen. Werden sie die Rutschwand bezwingen und das richtige Loch in der Fallgrube auswählen? Roman Kemp moderiert den Wahnsinn.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Werden die Kandidaten dieser Woche die Hängebrücke bezwingen? Gelingt es ihnen, die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen? Findet es gemeinsam mit Moderator Roman Kemp heraus.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert, während 100 neue Kandidaten in Spielen wie 'Bienenwabe' und 'Der große Jäger' auf die Probe gestellt werden. Wird es ihnen gelingen, die Burg von Takeshi zu stürmen?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Takeshi’s Castle geht in eine neue Runde, und Moderator Roman Kemp versucht, ein wenig Ordnung in die verrückteste aller Spielshows zu bringen. Lacher und Niederlagen säumen den Weg entlang der verschiedenen Spiele.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Roman Kemp moderiert das brandneue 'Takeshi’s Castle'. Erkämpfen sich die Kandidaten ihren Weg ins Finale, oder macht ihnen der 'Drahtseilakt' oder die 'Fallgrube' einen Strich durch die Rechnung?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: In der brandneuen Version von 'Takeshi’s Castle' bezwingen die Kandidaten die lustige Rutschwand und die bekannte Bienenwabe. Wer wird diese Woche gewinnen? Findet es gemeinsam mit Moderator Roman Kemp heraus.

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Willkommen zurück zum lustigen 'Takeshi’s Castle'! Erlebt gemeinsam mit Roman Kemp eine Menge Spaß. Einhundert Kandidaten kämpfen um das Finale, aber machen ihnen die Rutschwand oder die Bienenwabe einen Strich durch die Rechnung?

programme.title: Takeshi's Castle Indonesia
programme.desc: Staffelfinale der urkomischen Serie 'Takeshis’s Castle'! Erlebt den Wahnsinn gemeinsam mit Roman Kemp. Die Kandidaten müssen den Fliegenpilz und eine rutschige Wand bezwingen, bevor sie zur Burg gelangen.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Stimpys großer Tag
programme.desc: Nachdem er einen Wettbewerb bei "Gritty Kitty-Katzenstreu" gewonnen hat, verläßt Stimpy Ren, um ein Hollywood-Star in der Muddy Matschhüpfer Show zu werden.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Robin Höek / Schwester Stimpy
programme.desc: Robin Höek:Ren träumt, er wäre "Robin Höek", der tapfere Kämpfer, der das Geld der Reichen klaut.Schwester Stimpy:Als Ren krank wird, bietet sich Stimpy an, ihn rund um die Uhr zu betreuen, damit er schnell wieder gesund wird.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Weltraumkoller / Von Mäusen und Menschen
programme.desc: Weltraumkoller:Commander Höek und Kadett Stimpy, befinden sich auf einer Mission im Weltall. Doch Ren wird vom Weltraumkoller befallen.Von Mäusen und Menschen:Abgebrannt und hungrig beschließen Ren und Stimpy, daß sie sich Jobs suchen müssen.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Feuerwehrhunde / Der kleinste Riese
programme.desc: Feuerwehrhunde:Ren und Stimpy werden als Feuerhunde bei der städtischen Feuerwehr angestellt. Der kleinste Riese:Stimpy kann nicht einschlafen. Darum liest er sich die Gutenachtgeschichte vom "Kleinsten Riesen" vor.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Das schwarze Loch / Stimpys Erfindung
programme.desc: Das schwarze Loch:Commander Höek und Kadett Stimpy reisen als erster Hund und erste Katze durch das tückische schwarze Loch. Stimpys Erfindung:Stimpy, der große Erfinder, bittet Ren, seine Erfindungen zu testen, u. a. Stimpys "Bleib oben-Socken".

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Haben oder nicht haben / Vorsicht, bissiger Pavian
programme.sub-title: Haben oder nicht haben / Vorsicht, bissiger Pavian
programme.desc: Stimpy wird von einem Glibber-Verkäufer bedrängt. Irgendwann kann er sich nicht mehr zurückhalten und kauft dem aufdringlichen Kerl den ganzen Glibber ab. / Ren und Stimpy haben sich ein paar köstliche Leckerbissen gesichert: schweinebacken.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Zirkusliliputaner / Nackte Tatsachen
programme.desc: Ren und Stimpy halten den Daumen in den Wind und trampen. Schließlich werden sie von Liliputanern mitgenommen, die in einem Zirkus arbeiten. // Sie werden in ein winziges Clownauto gesperrt und sehen wahnwitzigen Abenteuern entgegen.

programme.title: Ren & Stimpy: Ein Traum wird wahr / Lincolns Geheimnis
programme.sub-title: Ein Traum wird wahr / Lincolns Geheimnis
programme.desc: Rens Traum von Brustmuskeln wird wahr, in dem ihm Stimpy Fett aus seinem Hintern spendet. // Auf einer Schatzsuche öffnet Ren den Kopf des Lincoln Memorials. Jetzt müssen die beiden den Kopf reparieren bevor Seargent Big Butt Wind davon bekommt.

programme.title: I Live With Models: Die Redakteurin
programme.desc: Die einflussreiche Zeitschriftenredakteurin Joanna Vermouth bietet Scarlet eine große Chance an. Aber als Tommy sich einmischt, steht ihre ganze Karriere auf dem Spiel. Anna will Enriques Schlafzimmer und behauptet, dass es darin spukt.

programme.title: CGTN & UN Tourism ｜Exploring China’s New Tourism Frontier
programme.desc: This summer, inbound tourism in China continues to boom, with nearly 23 million inbound trips by foreign nationals recorded in the first half of this year. The growth has been supported in part by expanded visa-free access, more convenient transit policies and continued improvements in tourism services. At the same time, rural tourism is playing an increasingly important role in China’s rural revitalization strategy. programme.title: Who owns Britain?
programme.desc: One of the first things that surprised CGTN's Li Jianhua after moving to Britain was discovering that London’s iconic black cabs are made by a subsidiary of China’s Geely. It’s not alone. Jaguar Land Rover belongs to India’s Tata, Mini is owned by Germany’s BMW, and many of Britain’s airports, utilities and landmark buildings have foreign owners. In this latest episode of his series Observing Europe, Jianhua explores ownership, investment – and where Britain is drawing the line.

programme.title: Cheers: Sams Ladehemmung
programme.desc: Rebecca ist trotz stetigen Beischlafs mit Sam noch immer nicht schwanger. Also vermutet sie, dass er unfruchtbar ist. Für den selbstbewussten Frauenheld Sam bricht eine Welt zusammen.

programme.title: Cheers: Die Babymacher

programme.title: Cheers: Mein Sohn, der Priester

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game "Sifu" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to "eat porridge at night"

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's "influencer hotspots", attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game "Sifu" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to "eat porridge at night"

programme.title: China Bound：Suzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China’s most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang’s First Peak – this time, he’s all in.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan-0
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: China's Ancient “Wall Street”: Pingyao
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Pingyao – the ancient "Wall Street" of China and a historic banking hub. Enclosed by ancient city walls and seemingly frozen in time, this entire city, together with two nearby ancient temples, offers a one-of-a-kind adventure at this UNESCO World Heritage Site!

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

Tianran discovers a city of refined tastes, where even a bowl of breakfast noodles comes with unspoken etiquette, locals insist on only in-season produce, and foodies eagerly await the arrival of prized hairy crabs.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Mount Siguniang
programme.desc: In this episode, Host Tianran He is on a mission: To reach the summit of Mount Siguniang, a towering snowcapped mountain in southwestern China. Together with his friend Ma Chunlin, a photographer for National Geographic, they trek through one of China’s most beautiful and biodiverse hiking routes, before making for base camp. But with worsening weather conditions and severe altitude sickness, the odds are stacked against them. Ten years ago, Tianran failed his attempt at climbing Mount Siguniang’s First Peak – this time, he’s all in.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan-0
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, to meet more outstanding women from the cities of Hengyang and Zhuzhou. By documenting snippets of the daily lives and work of a paper-cutting artist, the director of the Hengyang Huagu Opera Troupe, and an inheritor of Liling porcelain craftsmanship, we gain vivid insights into the distinctive cultural traditions of this region.

programme.title: China's Ancient “Wall Street”: Pingyao
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Pingyao – the ancient "Wall Street" of China and a historic banking hub. Enclosed by ancient city walls and seemingly frozen in time, this entire city, together with two nearby ancient temples, offers a one-of-a-kind adventure at this UNESCO World Heritage Site!

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

programme.title: Village Voyage: Before the icon Bruce Lee, there was Shunde in Foshan-0
programme.desc: Nunchucks. Dark shades. A yellow jumpsuit. That unmistakable nose wipe. Blinding punches and the snake feint – one name says it all: Bruce Lee, the man who brought Chinese martial arts to the world. But every legend has a beginning – and his is less well known. It started in Shunde of Foshan City, south China's Guangdong Province. Join Julian Waghann from the US and Absalom Absalom from Namibia as they trace Lee's roots – following the footsteps of an icon back to where it all began.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Pak Mei
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber seeks out Liu Weixin, a master of Pak Mei kungfu and on whom the hit game "Sifu" was based. He experiences for himself this style's relentless and lightning-fast strikes, but also learns from its master how to balance life and kungfu, how a master should treat his disciples, and what it means to "eat porridge at night"

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature. Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: China Bound: Chengdu
programme.desc: Tianran spends 3 days in Chengdu, the capital of Sichuan Province and UNESCO's first City of Gastronomy. He dives deep into Chengdu culture, exploring the infamous "mala" numbing and spicy flavors of Sichuanese street food and hotpot, and visiting historical attractions like Wuhou Shrine, Du Fu's Thatched Cottage, and the Jinsha Site Museum, which houses exquisite relics from a 3,000-year-old kingdom uncovered beneath the streets of Chengdu. Of course, no visit to this city is complete without seeing giant pandas and enjoying a cup of tea while getting your ears cleaned in the iconic People's Park. After all, when in Chengdu, do as the locals do.

programme.title: Thrill Seeker’s Guide to China: Changbai Mountain
programme.desc: An unforgettable adventure awaits amidst the breathtaking landscapes of Changbai Mountain! Embark on a trek through pristine birch forests, marvel at the majestic power of the world's deepest volcanic waterfall, and uncover hidden gems along the way. Indulge in soaking in natural hot springs and experience exhilarating rafting down mountain streams, all leading to the final destination: Tianchi Lake, a heavenly oasis nestled in the clouds. Join the Travelogue team as we delve into the beauty of Changbai Mountain.

programme.title: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life-0
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter—that’s the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, traveling to the cities of Zhuzhou and Xiangtan to meet another group of extraordinary women. By capturing snippets of the lives and work of an electric locomotive designer, a flight instructor, a painter, and a poverty alleviation volunteer, we showcase the unique cultural and humanistic charm of this region.

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast. Together with the locals, we celebrate their most magnificent festival: the Torch Festival.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: La cible : un dépôt de missiles à Hanoï. L'avion : l'A-6 Intruder, un bombardier à basse altitude sans aucune arme défensive. Le risque : la cour martiale présidée par le commandant Camparelli... s'ils reviennent vivants.

programme.title: Congo
programme.desc: Lorsque la quête d'une mine de diamants conduit tragiquement un explorateur au Congo, son père et le directeur de l'opération envoit Dr. Karen Ross dans la jungle pour rechercher... peut-être son fils, mais principalement les diamants.

programme.title: Four Brothers
programme.desc: Quatre frères adoptés se retrouvent pour enterrer la femme qui les a élevés. Lors des funérailles, les frères découvrent que leur mère a été tuée et vont chercher à se venger.

programme.title: Nick Of Time
programme.desc: Un modeste comptable se trouve pris dans un terrible piège lorsque sa fille est enlevée sous ses yeux afin de l'obliger à assassiner une femme politique influente. Il se rend compte que les services de sécurité font partie du complot.

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: Juste après le décollage, Jackson, le voisin de Lisa, révèle la véritable raison de sa présence à bord : il est un agent qui doit tuer un homme d'affaires riche et puissant... Et Lisa est la clé de son succès.

programme.title: The Run
programme.desc: Cinq personnes sont bloquées dans un ascenseur du World Trade Center au matin du 11 septembre 2001.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: Jae et son frère partent en road trip dans la Death Valley, majestueuse et impitoyable.

programme.title: La suma de todos los miedos
programme.desc: La tensión entre Oriente y Occidente estalla cuando la CIA sospecha que científicos rusos disidentes están desarrollando más armas nucleares.

programme.title: Asesinatos accidentales: unas vacaciones para morir
programme.desc: Mike Fallon está de regreso y debe vencer a los mejores asesinos del mundo, para proteger al hijo de un jefe de la mafia, salvar la vida de su único amigo y reavivar su relación con su figura paterna.

programme.title: Frontera hostil
programme.desc: Luego de ser deportada, Claudia debe elegir entre reconciliarse con su padre, de quien está distanciada, o juntarse con un peligroso contrabandista para poder volver a Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Sangre, sudor y gloria
programme.desc: Un equipo de fisicoculturistas de Miami llevan una vida de lujo a través del secuestro y de la extorsión en esta comedia policial basada en una historia real.

programme.title: Domino
programme.desc: Para buscar justicia por el asesinato de su compañero, un agente de policía de Copenhague (Nikolaj Coster-Waldau) y un compañero se embarcan en una misión mortal para dar caza a un misterioso hombre en este trepidante thriller de acción.

programme.title: La estafa maestra
programme.desc: Tras ser traicionados y abandonados a su suerte en Italia, Charlie Croker y su equipo planean un elaborado robo de oro contra su antiguo aliado.

programme.title: Fiebre Del Sabado Por La Noche
programme.desc: Protagonizado por John Travolta como Tony Manero, un talentoso bailarín de Brooklyn que busca escapar de su vida rutinaria a través de la música disco y las competiciones de baile, mientras enfrenta conflictos personales y familiares.

programme.title: La Mexicana
programme.desc: Un hombre trata de llevar a través de la frontera una antigua pistola llamada La Mexicana, que se cree que está maldita, mientras su novia lo presiona para que abandone sus costumbres criminales.

programme.title: Las estafadoras
programme.desc: Una mujer y su hija son estafadoras profesionales que utilizan sus armas de seducción para engañar a millonarios, hasta que la joven hija se enamora poniendo en apuros el último golpe: un excéntrico magnate del tabaco.

programme.title: Alfie, el seductor irresistible
programme.desc: Cuando las consecuencias de su estilo de vida afectan a la mujer que ama y a su mejor amigo (Omar Epps), Alfie comienza a preguntarse si hay cosas más importantes que estos romances pasajeros. De ser así, ¿de qué se trata?

programme.title: Soltero en casa
programme.desc: Tripp, de 35 años, nunca ha sido capaz de abandonar el nido. Ahora, sus desesperados padres no aguantan más. Ellos contratan la atractiva y talentosa chica de sus sueños para que lo haga abandonar la casa familiar.

programme.title: Novio por una noche
programme.desc: Un dentista guapo pero un poco egocéntrico (Dane Cook) descubre que es un amuleto andante de la buena suerte, ya que las mujeres inevitablemente encuentran su alma gemela justo después de salir con él.

programme.title: Champs
programme.desc: Ce documentaire exceptionnel suit les destinées de Mike Tyson, Evander Holyfield et Bernard Hopkins sur le ring et en dehors.

programme.title: Train de Guerre - Le corridor de l'espoir
programme.desc: Lors de la bataille de Leningrad, de nombreuses femmes survécurent au terrible siège de la ville. Elles durent ensuite livrer des équipements militaires russes par le rail au péril de leur vie, risquant la confrontation avec les Nazis à chaque virage.

programme.title: A Mighty Heart
programme.desc: Un Cœur invaincu est l'adaptation du livre de Mariane Pearl sur l'histoire tragique et inoubliable de la vie et la mort de son mari, Danny Pearl, reporter au Wall Street Journal.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Deux beaux mecs font irruption dans l'univers de Cher : un nouveau camarade d'école sexy et son ex demi-frère à l'esprit carré mais bien mignon. Elle apprend maintenant que lorsqu'il s'agit d'amour, elle est nulle.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: 'Dreamgirls' vous en mettra plein la vue... et les oreilles, en vous racontant l'extraordinaire histoire de trois chanteuses qui apprennent que tout est possible lorsque l'on s'accroche à ses rêves.

programme.title: Bigoudis et permanente
programme.desc: Dans les années 80, Aurélie, 13 ans, rêve de se faire une permanente pour s’intégrer dans son nouveau collège. Mais quand ses parents fauchés l’amènent dans une école de coiffure pour économiser de l’argent sur sa coupe, les choses dérapent…

programme.title: Cops Incrimination
programme.desc: Deux policiers arrêtent une voiture et tuent le conducteur, un jeune afro-américain qu’ils croyaient armé. Le père de la victime, un juge, décide de prendre la justice entre ses mains lorsque les deux policiers sont innocentés.

programme.title: Turbulence
programme.desc: Après une fusillade à bord d'un avion transportant des prisonniers, une hôtesse de l'air doit se montrer plus maline qu'un serial-killer enjôleur et faire atterrir l'avion.

programme.title: Code 252: Signal de détresse
programme.desc: Suite à un tremblement de terre survenu à Tokyo, la température de l'Océan Pacifique grimpe dangereusement. Une tempête impressionnante, puis un tsunami s'abattent sur la ville. Des survivants vont tenter de transmettre le code 252, synonyme de secours.

programme.title: The Last Wave
programme.desc: Une catastrophe naturelle menace d’engloutir les États-Unis. Un groupe de scientifiques tente d’arrêter l’inévitable avant qu’il ne soit trop tard.

programme.title: Secousse Sismique
programme.desc: Charley Baxter découvre qu'un tremblement de terre géant va annihiler le nord de l'Atlantique. Il doit désormais travailler avec le Dr Amy Lane, sismologue, afin d'arrêter le gouffre qui menace de couper l'Amérique et le reste du monde en deux.

programme.title: Hours
programme.desc: Alors que l’ouragan Katrina frappe la Nouvelle-Orléans, un jeune père doit lutter pour la survie de son bébé prématuré dans un hôpital déserté de tous… ou presque.

programme.title: 2012: Supernova
programme.desc: Quand une étoile dans une galaxie voisine devient instable, une supernova, un astrophysicien réalise un plan dangereux et désespéré pour protéger la Terre des radiations qui la menacent.

programme.title: Ape Vs Mecha ape
programme.desc: Reconnaissant la puissance de son gigantesque singe captif, l'armée crée son propre A.I. prêt au combat, Mecha Ape. Mais son premier test tourne horriblement mal.

programme.title: Les racines de l’Apocalypse
programme.desc: Une société biotechnologique découvre que des graines du jardin d'Eden peuvent améliorer l'environnement. Mais, entre de mauvaises mains, elles déclenchent la croissance de racines anciennes, menaçant la planète de tsunamis et de tremblements de terre.

programme.title: Crazy Fist
programme.desc: Shanghai s'est juré de ne plus jamais monter sur un ring après avoir tué son adversaire par accident lors de son dernier combat. Mais lorsque son frère est tué dans un tournoi de boxe clandestin, il décide d'investiguer sur sa mort.

programme.title: Haemoo
programme.desc: Capitaine d’un bateau de pêche menacé d’être vendu par son propriétaire, Kang décide de racheter lui-même le navire pour sauvegarder son poste et son équipage. Mais la pêche est insuffisante, et l’argent vient à manquer.

programme.title: Le Sorcier et le Serpent blanc
programme.desc: Un herboriste tombe amoureux d'un serpent vieux de cent ans déguisé sous les traits d'une femme. C'est alors qu'un sorcier découvre la supercherie et se bat pour sauver l'âme du vieil homme.

programme.title: Heroes : The Battle at Lake Changjin
programme.desc: Pendant la guerre de Corée, des soldats chinois se battent dans des conditions extrêmes contre les forces ennemies.

programme.title: Fukushima 50
programme.desc: Les héros anonymes de la catastrophe nucléaire de Fukushima risquent leur vie pour empêcher une explosion encore plus dévastatrice.

programme.title: The Admiral - Roaring Currents FR
programme.desc: A la fin du XVIIème siècle, le Royaume de Joseon est sous la menace d’une invasion japonaise. La dynastie s’en remet à l’Amiral Yi, commandant de la flotte royale, qui n’a plus à sa disposition qu’une douzaine de navires pour défendre le royaume.

programme.title: The Moon
programme.desc: En 2029, la sonde lunaire coréenne Woori entame un voyage historique vers la lune. Mais un vent solaire frappe la sonde, laissant l’astronaute Hwang Sun-woo isolé et à la dérive. L'ancien chef du centre, Kim Jae-guk, qui a démissionné il y a cinq ans...
